projects.name: linux
projects.style:
Dialect: gas-x86
Overrides:
  - Files: ["arch/arm64/**"]
    Dialect: gas-aarch64
  - Files: ["arch/arm/**"]
    Dialect: gas-arm
  - Files: ["arch/riscv/**"]
    Dialect: gas-riscv

projects.name: ffmpeg
projects.style:
Dialect: nasm
Overrides:
  - Files: ["**/aarch64/**"]
    Dialect: gas-aarch64
  - Files: ["**/arm/**"]
    Dialect: gas-arm

projects.name: dav1d
projects.style:
Dialect: nasm
Overrides:
  - Files: ["src/arm/*.S", "src/arm/64/*", "tests/checkasm/arm/*64*"]
    Dialect: gas-aarch64
  - Files: ["src/arm/32/*", "tests/checkasm/arm/*32*"]
    Dialect: gas-arm
  - Files: ["**/riscv/**"]
    Dialect: gas-riscv

projects.name: x264
projects.style:
Dialect: nasm
Overrides:
  - Files: ["common/aarch64/*", "tools/checkasm-a64.S"]
    Dialect: gas-aarch64
  - Files: ["common/arm/*", "tools/checkasm-arm.S"]
    Dialect: gas-arm

projects.name: musl
projects.style:
Dialect: gas-x86
Overrides:
  - Files: ["**/aarch64/*"]
    Dialect: gas-aarch64
  - Files: ["**/arm/*"]
    Dialect: gas-arm
  - Files: ["**/riscv64/*", "**/riscv32/*"]
    Dialect: gas-riscv

projects.name: compiler-rt
projects.style:
Dialect: gas-x86
Overrides:
  - Files: ["compiler-rt/lib/builtins/aarch64/*", "compiler-rt/lib/**/*_aarch64.S"]
    Dialect: gas-aarch64
  - Files: ["compiler-rt/lib/builtins/arm/*"]
    Dialect: gas-arm
  - Files: ["compiler-rt/lib/builtins/riscv/*", "compiler-rt/lib/**/*_riscv64.S"]
    Dialect: gas-riscv
  - Files: ["llvm/test/**"]
    Dialect: masm

projects.name: 7zip
projects.style:
Dialect: masm
Overrides:
  - Files: ["Asm/arm64/*"]
    Dialect: gas-aarch64
